key_findings: Oral semaglutide reduced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in STZ diabetic rats, and lowered HbA1c, AGEs and lipids with little effect on body weight.
Semaglutide reduced spinal dorsal horn microglial (IBA-1) and astrocyte (GFAP) activation and TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6 levels.
